description: Land Acquisition - Winchfield Park Watta, Ududumbara D/S Division, Kandy District  and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1716/21 of 27.07.2011, Kalawana D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains notices for acquiring land servitude for public purpose (conservation of Dumbara Mountain Range) and corrections to previous land acquisition schedules. The content focuses on specific land descriptions, extents, locations, and claimant information, which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
